title: Documents
description: Your professional documents. Each needs the final file itself.

id.description: Web address for this document. Lowercase, no spaces, unique.

type.description: Must be exactly one of these three. Picks the icon and label.

file_url.description: e.g. "/documents/my-cv.pdf". Put the file in public/documents/.

description.description: One line, shown on the card.

summary.description: Longer intro at the top of the detail page.

external_url.description: Optional live link, e.g. your LinkedIn.
